origin.description: Loads one named object from a package lazy-load database.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Loads one named object from a package lazy-load database.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
x <- read_builtin("mtcars", "datasets")
paste(nrow(x), sprintf("%.17g", x$mpg[1]), sprintf("%.17g", x$mpg[nrow(x)]), paste(names(x), collapse = ","), sep = "|")
